name: animated-theme-switch
title: Animated Theme Switch
description: Switch between light and dark with a transition.

props.name: theme
props.label: Theme
props.description: Colour palette. Any theme but Default also tints the sun and moon icon, except on the Default button, which is already primary.

props.name: revealAnimation
props.label: Reveal animation
props.description: How the new theme spreads over the old one.

props.name: duration
props.label: Duration
props.description: How long the theme change takes, in seconds.

props.name: iconAnimation
props.label: Icon motion
props.description: How the sun and moon icons swap.

props.name: showTooltip
props.label: Tooltip
props.description: Shows a tooltip naming the theme the button switches to.

props.name: variant
props.label: Look
props.description: Style of the button: outline, ghost (no border) or filled.
